7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: The royal convoy finally arrived at the entrance to the Alliance of Nations Headquarters in Konstantium.
7.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Lespia_SanctionsRizia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Lespia_SanctionsRizia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true) == false)

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: After the usual greetings, Laurento and I settled at our table in the conference hall.
8.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_Sabotage_Plans_Discovered"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Revolutionary_Pipeline_Sabotage"] == true) == false)

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: I looked around the foyer. Of all the leaders gathered here, we'd made the most grandiose entrance by far. I felt good about today.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: He leaned over and whispered in my ear.

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "What's the worst thing that can happen?"

16.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
16.text: "It should be over in a heartbeat."

18.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
18.text: "Very well. On to the first item on the agenda."

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: A man that I recognized as President Nines approached the podium.

21.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
21.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Lespia_SanctionsRizia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true

22.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
22.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Lespia_SanctionsRizia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: Prime Minister Saltana turned to face me head-on as I approached her.

33.speaker: Alma Saltana
33.text: "Your Majesty. So nice to see you here."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "Enough small talk. I know all about your sabotage plans."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "You too, Madam Prime Minister. Despite the circumstances."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "You've got some nerve, showing your face in these chambers after what you did."

42.speaker: Alma Saltana
42.text: "Morella didn't plan anything. Your own people were the ones attempting to take the Rizian energy grid into their own hands."

44.speaker: Alma Saltana
44.text: "Titles are important to you Rizians, aren't they?"

46.speaker: Alma Saltana
46.text: "I'm sorry, but the session's just about to start. We'll talk another time."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "We'll talk now. Or I'll reveal your plans to sabotage our energy infrastructure to this entire assembly."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "You can't fool me. Pretending to be Little Miss Do-Gooder while plotting to blow up our pipelines..."

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "Please, Ms. Saltana. I'm giving you a chance to explain yourself. You may not get another."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "So you wouldn't mind if I revealed your involvement to everyone at the Alliance of Nations?"

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "They never would have done such a thing on their own. You and your CSP partners drove them to it."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "Cut the bullshit. We have concrete proof of your involvement."

54.speaker: Alma Saltana
54.text: "No harm has been done. And I'm willing to listen to whatever it is you want."

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: That is, until I realized that none of the various delegations I passed were making eye contact with me.

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: Laurento caught up to me with quick steps. His words came in a worried whisper.

61.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
61.text: "I've just spoken to an old friend of mine. Deivid Wisci, the Sordish foreign minister."

65.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
65.text: "Despite the deteriorating relations between our countries, he was willing to divulge that Lespia is planning on proposing sanctions on Rizia at today's session."

69.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
69.text: "Despite the deteriorating relations between our countries, he was willing to divulge that Valgsland is planning on proposing sanctions on Rizia at today's session."
69.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Sordland_Hostile"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Sordland_Unfriendly"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true) == false)

73.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
73.text: "He confided that Lespia is planning on proposing sanctions on Rizia at today's session."
73.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Sordland_Hostile"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Sordland_Unfriendly"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true)

74.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
74.text: "He confided that Valgsland is planning on proposing sanctions on Rizia at today's session."
74.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Sordland_Hostile"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Sordland_Unfriendly"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true) == false)

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "How dare Alvarez pull a stunt like this after what Lespia did to us?"

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "How dare Hegel pull a stunt like this after what his Morellan minions did to us?"

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "And you're sure this Deivid is a trustworthy source?"

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "Well, I can't say I'm surprised to hear that."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "What? The other member states will never go along with it."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "What? The other member states will never go along with it."

87.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
87.text: "The man doesn't have a dishonest bone in his body."

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: Laurento caught up to me with quick steps. I had to strain to hear his words.
89.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Valgsland_GlobalImage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true)

90.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
90.text: "Rusty came through, Your Majesty. The documents he provided indeed implicate Lespia in the Friendship Day incident."

94.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
94.text: "But I don't know what you intend to do with this evidence. After all, you and Prime Minister Alvarez agreed that Lespia's involvement would be kept secret."

98.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
98.text: "If this comes to light, the other AN states will never agree to Smolak's referendum."

102.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
102.text: "But I'm not sure what good this information does now. You've already managed to negotiate Zille's safe return, after all."

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "I said I'd destroy the evidence our investigation had turned up. I never agreed to keep Lespia's involvement a secret."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "Lespia must be held accountable for its crimes. It's time to shame Prime Minister Alvarez on a global stage."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "For now. Who knows what Smolak will try to pull at the last minute?"

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "I haven't decided what to do yet. But it's a useful piece of leverage to have."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "This is it. Zille will be ours again."

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: A voice over the loudspeaker announced that it was time to take our seats.
108.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Valgsland_GlobalImage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true) == false)

109.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
109.text: "If these sanctions go through, they have the potential to severely damage our economy and our foreign standing."

114.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
114.text: "But we do have one useful piece of leverage. Rusty came through with his evidence. We now possess conclusive proof that Lespia organized the Friendship Day bombing."

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "Wow. I didn't think Rusty had it in him."

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "Perfect. It's time to shame Alvarez on a global stage."

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "We can use it to stop the sanctions and get back Zille at the same time. Two victories for the price of one."

124.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
124.text: "At the expense of our relations with Lespia. But those were never going to recover, I fear."

125.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
125.text: "He didn't get to where he is by being bad at subterfuge."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "I don't know what good that'll do."

128.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
128.text: "At the very least, it will make Lespia look hypocritical for accusing us of wrongdoing."

129.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
129.text: "But not everyone in this hall will be on our accuser's side. I'm sure of that."

131.speaker: Narrator
131.text: He sharply banged his gavel to begin the session.

132.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
132.text: "Good morning. I hereby open this session of the Alliance of Nations."

139.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
139.text: "Today's agenda includes a proposal of sanctions on the Kingdom of Rizia, a vote regarding the disputed territory of Heljiland, and a discussion on the region of Zille."
139.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Valgsland_GlobalImage"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Disapproved"] == true)

140.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
140.text: "I additionally invite all member states to share any other urgent matters you believe deserve our collective attention."

141.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
141.text: "Today's agenda includes a proposal of sanctions on the Kingdom of Rizia and a vote regarding the disputed territory of Heljiland."
141.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Valgsland_GlobalImage"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Disapproved"] == true) == false)

142.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
142.text: "Today's agenda includes a vote regarding the disputed territory of Heljiland and a discussion on the region of Zille."
142.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Valgsland_GlobalImage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Disapproved"] == true)

146.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
146.text: "Today's agenda includes a vote regarding the disputed territory of Heljiland."
146.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Valgsland_GlobalImage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Disapproved"] == true) == false)

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "The Kingdom of Rizia would like to draw this assembly's attention to the crimes perpetrated by the Republic of Lespia."

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: One of my aides approached President Nines' podium with the evidence Rusty had given us. Gasps and animated chatter filled the chamber.

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "I submit to you all conclusive proof that Lespia organized the Friendship Day incident of 1951."

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "An anonymous source bravely disclosed to us that Lespia has secretly been attempting to sow discord between Rizia and Wehlen."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "Patricio Alvarez tried to buy my silence. But I hold in my hands the truth about his misdeeds."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "Prime Minister Alvarez will point the finger at Rizia today. He is only trying to divert the blame from his government's attempts to sabotage our kingdom."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "I have evidence that Lespia and its backers in ATO actively worked to destabilize us."

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: I looked across the room at Alvarez. His face was white with rage, but he said nothing.

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "Fortunately, Rizia and Wehlen were able to see through the lies and reconcile our differences. Nonetheless, our would-be saboteurs must be held to account."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "We hope that the members of this assembly will keep this information in mind as the session continues."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "This blatant meddling is proof of the deep contempt the Arcasian Treaty Organization holds for the countries of South Merkopa."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "Lespia's act of terrorism killed civilians and directly impeded the return of the Zille region. They must be held to account."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "Our neighbors to the north are jealous of our resources and our great monarchy. But we will not let them tear us down."

181.speaker: Narrator
181.text: A stunned silence settled around the chamber as my words sunk in.

182.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
182.text: "Thank you, King Romus. The Alliance of Nations acknowledges the evidence submitted by the Kingdom of Rizia."

185.speaker: Dwight Walker (R)
185.text: "Let the record show Arcasia had no knowledge of Lespia's actions."

191.speaker: Narrator
191.text: A voice came from the back row.

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "Then I hope you discipline your member state accordingly. No nation must be allowed to act outside the law."

196.speaker: Narrator
196.text: At the same time, I noticed Prime Minister Alma Saltana trying to walk past me unnoticed.

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "You go on ahead. I just need a quick word with Madam Prime Minister over there.

204.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
204.text: "Looking forward to hearing what the little snake has to say for herself."

205.speaker: Narrator
205.text: He bowed and walked into the chamber.

208.speaker: Alma Saltana
208.text: "There's nothing to explain. Your own people were the ones attempting to take the Rizian energy grid into their own hands."

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "Don't try to lie to me. You threatened me with exactly this scenario when I didn't go along with your nationalization plans."

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: She gritted her teeth. It was a moment before she spoke.

214.speaker: Alma Saltana
214.text: "There's no need to involve anyone else."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "Not only that. You will vote in Rizia's best interests today."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "And you'll convince your friend Hegel not to threaten us with sanctions."

223.speaker: Player_Romus
223.text: "Very well. As long as your agents never touch Rizian soil again."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "I will decide what's best for my kingdom's workers. Not you. Do not forget that."

226.speaker: Alma Saltana
226.text: "It's too late for that. But I will vote in your favor, despite fully agreeing with the Chancellor."

228.speaker: Alma Saltana
228.text: "They won't. If there's a revolution in your country, it will be 100 percent homegrown."

229.speaker: Alma Saltana
229.text: "Then I entreat you to make the right decisions. Before it's too late."

230.speaker: Alma Saltana
230.text: "Thank you for your understanding, Your Majesty. I'll be taking my seat now."

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "Have a nice day, Madam Prime Minister."

234.speaker: Narrator
234.text: We parted ways and went to take our respective seats.
234.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_DiplomaticEnvoy_Morella"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_DiplomaticEnvoy_Morella"] == true) == false)

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: After the usual greetings, I settled next to Laurento at our table in the conference hall.

240.speaker: Narrator
240.text: At the same time, I noticed Prime Minister Alma Saltana standing nearby, trying to get my attention.
240.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_Sabotage_Plans_Discovered"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Revolutionary_Pipeline_Sabotage"] == true)

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "You go on ahead. I need a quick word with Madam Prime Minister."

243.speaker: Narrator
243.text: He bowed and walked into the chamber.

245.speaker: Narrator
245.text: Saltana turned to face me head-on as I approached her.

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "Changed your mind about my marriage offer?"

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "It's good to see you again, Ms. Saltana."

252.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
252.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Disapproved"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Valgsland_GlobalImage"] == true) == false

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "I hope I can count on you to vote in Rizia's favor today."

254.speaker: Alma Saltana
254.text: "You have Morella's support, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}. But that's not why I want to talk to you."

256.speaker: Alma Saltana
256.text: "Very busy. But there's something you should be aware of."

257.speaker: Narrator
257.text: She handed me a sheet of paper. On it was a list of names and addresses.

258.speaker: Alma Saltana
258.text: "I'll make this quick. Connections of mine have revealed a potential sabotage plot by revolutionaries in your country."

259.speaker: Alma Saltana
259.text: "They appear to be targeting your energy infrastructure. If they succeed, it'd be ruinous for our energy agreement."

263.speaker: Alma Saltana
263.text: "They appear to be targeting your energy infrastructure."

264.speaker: Alma Saltana
264.text: "I trust you to use this wisely."

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "I'll see to it that every individual on this list is punished to the full extent of the law."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "I value our agreement as much as you do. We'll take quick action to prevent disaster."

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "Your 'connections' revealed this plot? Was Morella in on it?"

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "Well, this is embarrassing. Why didn't Rizian intelligence get wind of it?"

274.speaker: Alma Saltana
274.text: "Some of the more extreme left-wingers in my coalition have had contact with Rizian anti-monarchists."

275.speaker: Alma Saltana
275.text: "A good question. I hope you'll be more attuned to this movement going forward."

281.speaker: Alma Saltana
281.text: "I'm looking forward to hearing more about this inter-Merkopan alliance you're proposing. But I have to say I'm troubled that a portion of your society feels they have to resort to desperate measures to be heard."

282.speaker: Alma Saltana
282.text: "I have to say I'm troubled that a portion of your society feels they have to resort to desperate measures to be heard."

283.speaker: Alma Saltana
283.text: "Just be careful. You wouldn't want to spark a backlash."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "These are rogue dissidents. They don't represent the opinion of the entire working class."

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "You don't have to worry. I am listening to their demands for reform and I'm planning to act."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "I hear them just fine. But they are demanding too much."

291.speaker: Alma Saltana
291.text: "Very intriguing. I hope you'll keep us informed."

293.speaker: Player_Romus
293.text: "You really don't need to concern yourself with the political situation in Rizia."

294.speaker: Alma Saltana
294.text: "Apparently I do. Or would you prefer your pipelines exploded?"

295.speaker: Alma Saltana
295.text: "It doesn't seem like too much to me."

296.speaker: Narrator
296.text: The loudspeaker voice repeated the announcement. Saltana turned towards the conference hall doors.

297.speaker: Alma Saltana
297.text: "I'll be taking my seat now. See you in there."

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "Have a nice day, Madam Prime Minister."

300.speaker: Player_Romus
300.text: "Don't forget to vote the right way."

303.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
303.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Lespia_GlobalImage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Disapproved"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANSanctionAccusation_Valgsland_GlobalImage"] == true) == false

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "First things first. You are to expedite our MITZ shipments from this point onward. No more obstruction."

311.speaker: Player_Romus
311.text: "First things first. You are to honor our MITZ agreement. No matter if Rizia doesn't hold up our end of the bargain."

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "Call off the MITZ talks. We're going back to the way things were."

313.speaker: Alma Saltana
313.text: "It's too late to call them off completely. But if Rizia insists on the status quo, I will not get in your way."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "Adarfo Sotelato. Is he one of yours?"

319.speaker: Alma Saltana
319.text: "But in the case that any of his supporters have links to Morella... they will cease being a problem from now on."

320.speaker: Player_Romus
320.text: "How many of your people are embedded in the RPP?"

322.speaker: Alma Saltana
322.text: "But in the case that any of the party's supporters have links to Morella... they will cease being a problem from now on."
